characters.identity_anchors: Small stuffed rabbit, fat and bunchy body; spotted brown-and-white velveteen coat; real thread whiskers; ears lined with pink sateen; boot-button eyes; initially no separate hind legs (back made in one piece like a pincushion); later transforms to living brown-furred rabbit with long whiskers, twitching ears, and working hind legs, retaining faint spotted markings under the fur
characters.source_evidence: Fat and bunchy as a rabbit should be; coat spotted brown and white; real thread whiskers; ears lined with pink sateen; boot-button eyes that lose polish; pink rubbed off nose; tail unsewn; whiskers loved off; ear lining turns grey; spots fade; back all in one piece; after Fairy kiss has brown fur soft and shiny, hind legs, ears that twitch, long whiskers; later strange markings under fur as though once spotted
characters.voice_label: soft gentle toy-voice, quiet and wondering, childlike sincerity

wardrobe_variants.description: Brand-new velveteen rabbit in pristine spotted brown-and-white coat, upright thread whiskers, bright pink sateen ear linings, polished boot-button eyes, sprig of holly between paws when first seen
source_facts: sprig of holly between his paws
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Christmas-morning gift sheen; slight stiffness of new stuffing; sits wedged charmingly

wardrobe_variants.description: Same new-ish velveteen rabbit now slightly less stiff from handling, still mostly intact coat and whiskers, expression shy among superior toys
source_facts: thought they were all stuffed with sawdust like himself
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Muted posture on cupboard floor or near fender; no damage yet

wardrobe_variants.description: Velveteen coat growing shabbier; tail becoming unsewn; pink rubbed off nose from kisses; still recognizably spotted but softer and limp from tight hugs
source_facts: beautiful velveteen fur was getting shabbier and shabbier
all the pink rubbed off his nose where the Boy had kissed him
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Sleep-tousled look; slight flattening from being rolled on and pushed under pillow

wardrobe_variants.description: Extremely worn: most whiskers loved off; pink ear lining turned grey; brown spots faded; losing shape so scarcely looks like a rabbit except to the Boy; coat thin and threadbare; boot-button eyes long ago lost polish but hold knowing look
source_facts: pink lining to his ears turned grey
scarcely looked like a rabbit any more
coat had worn so thin and threadbare from hugging
boot-button eyes that had long ago lost their polish
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Limp, earthy after garden, damp after dew; later mass of scarlet-fever association but still clutched

wardrobe_variants.description: Fully living rabbit: soft shiny brown fur instead of dingy velveteen; long whiskers that brush grass; ears that twitch by themselves; working hind legs for leaping and whirling; faint strange spotted markings still showing through under fur; familiar soft nose and round black eyes
source_facts: instead of dingy velveteen he had brown fur, soft and shiny
whiskers were so long that they brushed the grass
strange markings under his fur, as though long ago he had been spotted
little soft nose and his round black eyes
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Alive muscle and breath; joyous springing motion; one of two wild rabbits peeping from bracken

characters.identity_anchors: Young child, kind-hearted; small enough for nursery bed, wheelbarrow rides, and being carried to balcony in a shawl; face flushes with fever; hands that clasp rabbit all night; later well enough to play in wood again
characters.source_evidence: Receives rabbit in stocking; hugs tight, rolls over on him, makes tunnels and burrows; kind-hearted little boy; face grew very flushed, talked in his sleep, little body so hot; sits up in bed for picture-books; wrapped in shawl on balcony; goes to seaside; next spring plays in wood and peeps at rabbits
characters.voice_label: warm young-boy voice, earnest and affectionate, fierce when defending Bunny

wardrobe_variants.description: Child in period nightshirt or Christmas-morning play clothes, excited among new presents and stocking
source_facts: Aunts and Uncles came to dinner
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Edwardian/early-20th-century middle-class child nightwear or simple day clothes; bare feet or slippers in nursery

wardrobe_variants.description: Child in nightclothes ready for bed, arms outstretched for rabbit, later asleep with hands clasped round him
source_facts: hands clasped close round him all night long
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Simple white or striped nightshirt; rumpled bed hair

wardrobe_variants.description: Child in light outdoor play clothes suitable for wheelbarrow, picnics, flower-picking, and brigands among trees
source_facts: play at brigands among the trees
called away suddenly to go out to tea
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Short trousers, loose shirt or smock, possible sun-hat; grass-stained knees; spring-to-summer lightness

wardrobe_variants.description: Child flushed and hot in bed, later able to sit up propped with picture-books, then wrapped in shawl on balcony
source_facts: sit up in bed and look at picture-books
carried the Boy out on to the balcony, wrapped in a shawl
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Rumpled sickbed nightshirt; damp hair; shawl over shoulders for balcony; pale after fever turns

wardrobe_variants.description: Healthy child again in outdoor play clothes exploring the wood behind the house
source_facts: in the Spring, when the days grew warm and sunny, the Boy went out to play in the wood
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Same period play clothes as garden summers, now a year older in feel but still young child

characters.identity_anchors: Old stuffed skin horse, brown coat bald in patches showing seams underneath; most hairs in tail pulled out; wise gentle expression; has lived longer in nursery than any other toy
characters.source_evidence: so old that his brown coat was bald in patches and showed the seams underneath, and most of the hairs in his tail had been pulled out to string bead necklaces; wise; seen long succession of mechanical toys; Boy's Uncle made me Real
characters.voice_label: low gentle aged-toy voice, calm truthful warmth, unhurried

wardrobe_variants.description: Worn brown skin horse with bald patches, visible seams, sparse tail hairs, lying near nursery fender or on floor beside Rabbit
source_facts: brown coat was bald in patches and showed the seams underneath
most of the hairs in his tail had been pulled out
lying side by side near the nursery fender
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Soft collapsed posture of long-loved toy; no new accessories; quiet dignity

characters.identity_anchors: Adult woman who rules the nursery; practical, sometimes hurried and swooping like a great wind when tidying; grumbles but provides care; notices Rabbit's knowing expression
characters.source_evidence: person called Nana who ruled the nursery; went swooping about like a great wind and hustled them away; called this tidying up; dragged the Rabbit out by one ear; grumbled as she rubbed him off with a corner of her apron; Fancy all that fuss for a toy; I declare if that old Bunny hasn't got quite a knowing expression
characters.voice_label: brisk practical adult female voice, no-nonsense with underlying care

wardrobe_variants.description: Adult nursemaid in practical working dress with apron; capable of swooping tidying and rubbing dew off toys with apron corner
source_facts: swooping about like a great wind
rubbed him off with a corner of her apron
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Early-20th-century nursemaid uniform: plain dark dress, white apron, neat hair; sleeves rolled for work; candle in hand when searching lawn at dusk

characters.identity_anchors: Loveliest fairy; dress of pearl and dew-drops; flowers round neck and in hair; face like the most perfect flower; can gather rabbit in arms, kiss velveteen nose, fly with him, and magically change him
characters.source_evidence: quite the loveliest fairy in the whole world; dress was of pearl and dew-drops; flowers round her neck and in her hair; face was like the most perfect flower of all; gathered him up in her arms and kissed him on his velveteen nose; I am the nursery magic Fairy; flew with him into the wood
characters.voice_label: clear luminous gentle female voice, kind and certain, lightly magical

wardrobe_variants.description: Ethereal figure in dress of pearl and dew-drops, flowers at neck and in hair, stepping from golden-cup blossom
source_facts: dress was of pearl and dew-drops
flowers round her neck and in her hair
face was like the most perfect flower of all
out of it there stepped a fairy
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Moonlit iridescence; bare feet or light slippers; no wings specified so optional subtle suggestion only; holds rabbit tenderly

characters.identity_anchors: Living rabbits, quite furry and brand-new looking; seams do not show; change shape when moving (long and thin then fat and bunchy); feet pad softly; twitch noses; hop on hind legs; whirl and dance; long whiskers; white tails flash when fleeing; later dance with shadows on velvet grass
characters.source_evidence: rabbits like himself, but quite furry and brand-new; seams didn't show at all; changed shape in a queer way when they moved; feet padded softly; twitching their noses; hop sideways and stood on his hind legs; whirl round and dance; long whiskers brushed the Velveteen Rabbit's ear; flash of white tails; danced with their shadows on the velvet grass
characters.voice_label: quick bright natural rabbit voices, teasing then accepting, light and outdoor

wardrobe_variants.description: Two (or more) natural living rabbits with full fur, no visible seams, mobile bodies, twitching noses, able to stand and hop on hind legs and dance
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Authentic European rabbit coloring (browns/greys); alert wild posture; one may stretch neck to inspect; later ring around Fairy

characters.identity_anchors: Adult medical man who visits sickroom, pronounces on infection, orders burning of toys and new bunny replacement
characters.source_evidence: Strange people came and went; That? said the doctor. Why, it's a mass of scarlet fever germs!—Burn it at once. What? Nonsense! Get him a new one. He mustn't have that any more
characters.voice_label: brisk authoritative adult male professional voice

wardrobe_variants.description: Period physician in dark suit or coat, possibly with bag, standing in nursery assessing toys and giving orders
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Early-20th-century doctor's dark waistcoat and coat, stiff collar; practical rather than ceremonial; decisive gesture toward rabbit
